title: DPS registration (pre-hub)
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0, which is the WORKING TREE and is not committed. The nearest commit is b62b25e, which is a different firmware version - do not read x-commit as containing this behaviour. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: DPS provisioning (a separate broker). `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

registrationId.description: The device's registration id, which is its gateway id. The only key in the payload: no tags and no model id, so DPS enrolment tags cannot originate in firmware.
